subject: reasoning
question:
How many are both buttons and bottle?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2201876da5198207971aafc0ed080a6a0cbdf8b33b5950141e917c7e9eba4ab7.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78aa04e548727c7f44e1a009020577ef1f4e333ab19ee63091a873a1a61ebb0f.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of buttons and bottle".

So, the total number of buttons and bottle = 2 + 5 = 7.

Hence, the correct answer is "7".
